The mount position of the sensor in the room.
Set the points required to recognize an object. Lower values allow detection of smaller or partially visible objects.
Set the minimum signal strength to detect motion. Lower values increase sensitivity; higher values reduce false detections.
Set the minimum speed to detect an object. Use low values to better detect slow movement. Use high values to ignore slow or stationary objects.
Set the speed variance for grouping points as one target. Prevents unrelated motion (e.g., one object moving past another) from being grouped together.
Set the frames required to mark an object as active. Lower values react faster to motion; higher values improve stability and reduce false triggers.
Set the frames required to clear a detection. Lower values stop detection quickly; higher values help avoid flickering.
Set the frames required to clear an active object. Lower values switch sooner; higher values delay the transition.
Set the frames required to confirm a stationary object as presence. Higher values improve the detection of stationary objects.
Set the maximum time to hold a detection when no motion is sensed. Higher values maintain presence during long inactivity of stationary objects.

instruction.en: Enable Matter in the Shelly web interface. The required information for pairing will be shown after enabling.

Verify that the device is in Zigbee mode (you can enable Zigbee mode by holding button 1 and pressing button 4 five times).

Hold button 1 and press button 4 three times to initialize pairing.

Press and hold the S button on the device until the LED turns solid blue. Release the button and press and hold it again (> 2s) until the blue LED starts blinking. Repeat this for step 2 in the pairing process and enter the device key (pincode).
instruction.nl: Houd de S-knop op het apparaat ingedrukt totdat de LED continu blauw wordt. Laat de knop los en druk er opnieuw op en houd deze ingedrukt (> 2s) totdat de blauwe LED begint te knipperen. Herhaal dit voor stap 2 in het koppelingsproces en voer de apparaatsleutel (pincode) in.
